bullets.text: Affordable Portable Monitor - **MSI** Pro MP165 E6 offers basic functionality at a budget-friendly price of $89.
Apple's Year in Review - Highlights include **iOS 26** redesign leaks and the launch of the **iPhone 17** series.
ChatGPT Year Recap - **OpenAI** introduces 'Your Year with ChatGPT' feature for personalized user experiences.
iOS 26 Enhancements - New time zone support in **Reminders** app enhances usability for travelers.
Nostalgic Tech Story - A Spanish virus led to **Google** establishing a cybersecurity hub in Málaga.
Distraction Blockers for Focus - Apps like **Freedom** and **Cold Turkey** help boost productivity by blocking distractions.
Family Phone Plans - **T-Mobile** and **Verizon** offer competitive family plans for 2025.
Nvidia's Strategic Move - **Nvidia** licenses tech from **Groq**, enhancing its AI chip capabilities.
MagSafe Battery Innovation - The **Kuxiu S3** battery pack offers multifunctionality and reliability for Apple devices.
Streaming NFL on Christmas - Two games streamed on **Netflix** and one on **Prime Video** for holiday football.
